command_result.command: cd /app; find . -type f -not -path './.git/*' | head -100; cat docs/overview.md; wc -c docs/* data/*
cd /app/docs; cat exports.md codebook.md cleaning.md weighting.md tables.md output.md changelog.md
cd /app/docs; sed -n '/^## 5. Routing/,$p' codebook.md; cat cleaning.md weighting.md

cd /app; cat data/codebook.json data/weighting.json data/tables.json; cat data/exports/export_log.txt; head -c 600 data/exports/*.csv; cat tests/test_tables.py tools/check_tables.py | head -150; cat docs/../tests/fixtures/routing/input/tables.json

cd /app/data; python3 - <<'E'
import json
c=json.load(open('codebook.json'))
for q in c['questions'][8:]: print(json.dumps(q))
E
cat weighting.json tables.json export_log.txt exports/export_log.txt; for f in exports/*; do echo == $f; head -c 400 $f | cat -A | head -4; done
cd /app; mkdir -p out; python3 bin/crosstabs.py data out/tables.json && python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . 2>&1 | tail -15; python tools/check_tables.py | head -40

cd /app; echo '{"status":"success","summary":"Wrote /app/bin/crosstabs.py following the documented rules (exports, cleaning, routing, raking and trimming, weighted crosstabs) and ran it on /app/data to produce /app/out/tables.json. The unit tests pass and tools/check_tables.py reports every figure matching."}' > STATUS.json; python3 -c 'import json;print(json.load(open("STATUS.json")))'
